title: C₁V₁ = C₂V₂

references.label: General microbiology/quantitative methods references (ASM, FDA BAM)

explanation: Describes dilution of a stock solution: the amount of solute (concentration × volume) is conserved before and after dilution, since diluting only adds solvent, not solute.

workedExample.scenario: Preparing 500 mL of a 0.5 M solution from a 5 M stock (solving for V₁).
workedExample.result: V₁ = 50 mL of stock, brought to 500 mL total with solvent

commonMistakes: Mixing concentration units between C₁ and C₂ (e.g. mg/mL and M) without converting first — this formula assumes both concentrations are expressed in the same unit.
